title: Eyes On The Yard
style: Australian dark ambient, 55 BPM, deep industrial sub-bass, minimal percussion single kick with long decay, sonar ping sound design in the mix, infrared night surveillance energy, underwater listening tones whale low-frequency, camera static texture between verses, male spoken word barely above whisper deliberate pauses, silence as punctuation long space between lines, WA coast night patrol breath audible, outro fades to complete silence system armed, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass
lyrics:
[Intro – infrared static, sonar ping, single sub-bass kick, long silence]

[Verse 1 – whispered, deliberate, each line stands alone]
Red LED blink.
Camera 3 — dock clear.
Malaga yard 2am —
nobody here.
Boats roped in.
Fuel logged.
Keys hung.
Systems locked.
Helicopter comes at first light.
Clients don't see this.
They see turquoise.
They see reef.
I see the perimeter.
That's the job.

[Pre-Chorus]
No lights needed.
No recognition.
Paradise runs on what they don't see.
That's the position.

[Chorus – deep, minimal, weighted]
Eyes on the yard — red light, dark night
WA coast sleeping — we keep the light
Two boats resting before first run
Security holds while the skipper sleeps on
Helicopter shadow won't come till dawn
Till then it's camera feed and carry on
Indian Ocean doesn't ask your name
Eyes on the yard — every night the same

[Verse 2 – quieter]
Storm warning — west gust 35
Double tie the hulls.
System records it.
Everyone's alive.
Not glamour.
Not reef.
Not coral blue.
This is what the morning runs on.
This is the other view.

[Bridge – sub-bass and static alone, long pause]
System armed.
All clear.
All clear.

[Outro – silence]
